sections.overviewContent: BhashaBridge AI is a sovereign, voice-first multilingual AI system engineered specifically for Indian citizens. It bridges the critical digital accessibility divide by allowing citizens to speak naturally in Telugu, Hindi, or Indian English—including daily vernacular code-mixed phrases—to query government welfare schemes, agricultural subsidies, and healthcare benefits.
sections.problemContent: Over 800 million citizens in India rely predominantly on regional languages. Most digital government portals and critical public information repositories are written in dense bureaucratic English or formal text, creating severe hurdles for rural populations, elderly citizens, and individuals who are not text-literate.
sections.realWorldContent: Citizens often lose vital welfare assistance due to complex application jargon, lack of awareness, or predatory intermediaries. Existing proprietary voice AI solutions require costly cloud API tokens, high bandwidth, and suffer from high hallucination rates when reciting welfare eligibility rules.
sections.solutionContent: A full-stack, voice-native web ecosystem powered by a 7-agent architecture, local ChromaDB vector retrieval, client-native Web Speech API, and verified OpenRouter Free-tier LLMs with zero paid dependencies.
sections.obj1: Zero-Cost Access: Deliver end-to-end voice and text intelligence using client-native Web Speech API and open-source RAG.
sections.obj2: Dialect Understanding: Accurately process code-mixed queries (Tenglish like 'rythu bharosa ela apply cheyali' and Hinglish like 'pm kisan me kaise apply kare').
sections.obj3: Anti-Hallucination: Ground responses in verified institutional government documents (*.gov.in) with citation attribution.
sections.obj4: Bi-Directional Voice: Deliver voice question input and native speech read-aloud output on any modern browser.
sections.f1: Browser-Native Voice In & Out: Zero-latency Web Speech recognition and SpeechSynthesis TTS.
sections.f2: Strictly Free-First Architecture: Validated OpenRouter Free LLM router with zero credit requirement.
sections.f3: RAG with Scheme Citations: Real-time vector search across PM-Kisan, Ayushman Bharat, PMAY, and Rythu Bharosa.
sections.f4: Multi-Turn Session Memory: Preserves conversational context across questions.
sections.f5: Dynamic Motion Blur UI: Modern responsive interface with low-profile emerald styling.
sections.agentArchDesc: Each user turn is coordinated through an asynchronous pipeline of 7 specialized single-responsibility agents:
sections.step1: 1. Voice/Text Ingest: Citizen query is captured via Web Speech API or chat input.
sections.step2: 2. Language & Dialect Analysis: Language Agent parses Unicode codepoints and phonetic patterns to identify script and code-mixing.
sections.step3: 3. Semantic Vector Search: Knowledge Agent hashes query and retrieves top scheme chunks from ChromaDB.
sections.step4: 4. Domain Research: Research Agent validates retrieved context against trusted government knowledge bases.
sections.step5: 5. Grounded Generation: Response Agent synthesizes concise, culturally resonant explanation.
sections.step6: 6. Verification Audit: Verification Agent cross-checks numeric benefits against citations.
sections.step7: 7. Speech Synthesis: Voice Agent streams synthesized speech back to the citizen.
sections.ragDesc: The knowledge base is powered by ChromaDB with deterministic offline hashing embeddings. Schemas covered include PM-Kisan Samman Nidhi, Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY, Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana, Rythu Bharosa, and DigiLocker guidelines.
sections.voiceDesc: Voice interactions leverage client-side Web Speech API (webkitSpeechRecognition) and window.speechSynthesis. Speech recognition dynamically adjusts its language tag based on the active selection (te-IN, hi-IN, en-IN) with automatic fallback.
sections.stackFrontend: Frontend: React 18, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Lucide React, react-i18next
sections.stackGateway: Backend Gateway: Java 17, Spring Boot 3.2, Reactive WebClient
sections.stackAiEngine: AI Engine: Python 3.11, FastAPI, Uvicorn, Asyncio
sections.stackVector: Vector Store: ChromaDB with offline hashing embeddings
sections.apiDesc: The frontend communicates directly with FastAPI on port 8000 (or via Spring Boot Gateway on port 8080) through standardized endpoints: POST /api/chat, GET /health, and POST /api/voice/synthesize.
sections.langDesc: Complete system-wide localization across English, Telugu (తెలుగు), and Hindi (हिन्दी) covering navigation, hero content, console, assistant dialogs, agent specs, and technical documentation.
sections.secDesc: Zero client-side API key leakage. All LLM calls and vector queries occur inside the isolated backend environment. Strict CORS whitelisting and session tokenization.
sections.testDesc: Automated pytest suite for language detection, code-mixing parsing, and agent orchestration. Automated Vite production build verification and continuous regression testing.
sections.futureDesc: Expansion to all 22 scheduled Indian official languages, native Android deployment via Capacitor, and offline on-device whisper/ggml quantization.
sections.hackathonDesc: Developed for HackWithAditya 2026 under the 'AI for Bharat' track, demonstrating an accessible, production-ready, free-first sovereign AI platform.

howItWorks.title: How BhashaBridge Works
howItWorks.subtitle: A transparent, 4-step autonomous pipeline converting spoken regional queries into verified government intelligence.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Citizens ask questions naturally in Telugu, Hindi, or English using browser-native microphone or text input.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Language Agent inspects Unicode codepoints and phonetics to handle pure script or Latin-script transliterations (Tenglish/Hinglish).
howItWorks.step3Desc: Knowledge and Research agents retrieve verified policy guidelines from local vector collections.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Response Agent drafts clear answers, verified by the Verification Agent and read aloud via SpeechSynthesis.
